reason: FormatConfig gains poison_counter_threshold (CR 704.5c individual poison-loss threshold, host-adjustable; null for the Two-Headed Giant family), StructuralRules gains its mirror, and DerivedViews gains poison_loss (the per-player poison-loss rule the HUD displays). Defaulted and migrated on ingress, so either side parses, but a peer missing the field plays at the CR value and silently drops a host's house-rule threshold.
